description:
On 21st September, 2026, the Interact Club of Anjuman Islam organised a Beach Cleaning Driveat Badhwar Park, Colaba, encouraging environmental responsibility and community participation among students. Fifty students from Classes 7 to 10 enthusiastically participated, collecting plastic waste, wrappers, bottles and other litter from the beach. The activity also helped them understand the harmful impact of waste
on marine life and the wider environment. Beyond cleaning the coastline, the initiative highlighted the importance of responsible waste
disposal and sustainability. Through hands-on participation, students experienced how individual efforts can contribute to a meaningful collective
impact. The drive concluded with students reaffirming their commitment to becoming responsible citizens and environmental ambassadors.
